es: Explicar el mismo problema a un vecino y a la administración con el tono correcto en cada caso.

teaching.en: Hi Sam, the music is very loud at night.
teaching.es: Hola, Sam, la música está muy fuerte por la noche.
teaching.explanationEs: Al vecino: saludo corto y el problema dicho de forma directa.
teaching.audioText: Hi Sam, the music is very loud at night.

teaching.en: Sorry, but the noise is too loud. Could you turn it down, please?
teaching.es: Perdona, pero el ruido es demasiado fuerte. ¿Podrías bajarlo, por favor?
teaching.explanationEs: Petición amable e informal: could you … please.
segments: Sorry, but the noise is too loud.
Could you turn it down, please?

teaching.en: Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in the building.
teaching.es: Estimado Sr. Jones, le escribo para quejarme del ruido en el edificio.
teaching.explanationEs: A la administración: Dear + título y I am writing to complain about.

complain about the noise in the building.
teaching.audioText: Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in the building.

teaching.en: The music starts at midnight, and it stops at two.
teaching.es: La música empieza a medianoche y termina a las dos.
teaching.explanationEs: Un correo de queja da datos concretos: cuándo empieza y cuándo termina.
teaching.audioText: The music starts at midnight, and it stops at two.

teaching.en: I would like to ask you to solve this problem.
teaching.es: Querría pedirle que resuelva este problema.
teaching.explanationEs: Petición formal: I would like to ask you to + verbo.
teaching.audioText: I would like to ask you to solve this problem.

hint.es: Al vecino le escribes con un tono cercano y relajado.

feedback.es: El propósito de un correo se introduce con to + verbo base: I am writing to complain.

hint.es: Después de I am writing va la partícula que introduce el propósito.

origin.text: I am writing ___ complain about the noise.

prompt.es: Completa: «El ruido es fuerte. Como resultado, no puedo dormir.»

feedback.es: As a result introduce la consecuencia: por el ruido, no puedo dormir.

hint.es: Es el sustantivo que expresa la consecuencia de lo anterior.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase es la adecuada para el correo a la administración?

Hi! The noise is too loud, help!

feedback.es: I am writing to complain about… es una frase formal, completa y con propósito claro. Las otras opciones son coloquiales o bruscas.

prompt.es: Escribe un mensaje informal a tu vecino Sam sobre la música de la noche.

answer.text: Hi Sam, the music is very loud every night. As a result, I cannot sleep. Could you turn it down after midnight, please? Thanks for understanding!
accepted: Hi Sam, the music is very loud every night. As a result, I cannot sleep. Could you turn it down after midnight, please? Thanks for understanding!
Hi Sam, the music is very loud every night after midnight. I can't sleep. Can you turn it down, please? Thank you!
Hello Sam, your music is too loud at night. I can't sleep well. Could you turn the music down, please? Thanks!
Hi Sam, the music is very loud every night, so I can't sleep. Can you please turn it down? Thanks for understanding!

feedback.es: Un buen mensaje al vecino saluda con Hi, describe el problema, da la consecuencia con as a result y pide con Could you … please.

origin.text: Datos: la música suena muy fuerte cada noche desde medianoche; no puedes dormir; quieres que la baje.

prompt.es: Escribe el correo formal a la administración sobre el ruido (60 a 90 palabras).

answer.text: Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in our building. Every night the music from the apartment next to mine is very loud until two in the morning. As a result, I cannot sleep and my children are tired at school. My neighbour told me that he would turn it down; however, the problem continues. In addition, other families also complain. I would like to ask you to solve this problem. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Sara Lopez
accepted: Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to complain about the noise in our building. Every night the music from the apartment next to mine is very loud until two in the morning. As a result, I cannot sleep and my children are tired at school. My neighbour told me that he would turn it down; however, the problem continues. In addition, other families also complain. I would like to ask you to solve this problem. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, Sara Lopez

Dear Mr Jones, I am writing to tell you about the noise in our building. Every night my neighbour plays very loud music until two in the morning. feedback.es: Un correo formal abre con Dear Mr Jones, explica el propósito con I am writing to complain, da datos con as a result o in addition, cuenta lo que dijo el vecino con told me that y pide con I would like to ask you to.

origin.text: Datos: música muy fuerte cada noche hasta las dos; no puedes dormir y tus hijos están cansados en la escuela; el vecino dijo que la bajaría, pero sigue igual; pides una solución.
